subject: ours:why
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-17 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3. Gather step 4 now reads the project sources file .repo-context/evidence-sources.md: a source marked have is searched with its section of the new references/outside-sources.md, an alternative is searched instead, a not-here source is a known coverage gap in the sources line, a warehouse, observability or error tracker that is have or alternative also brings the shared runtime-signals section, and a missing file still yields an answer that lists the outside sources as not checked and suggests creating the file. subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/wayfinder#session-sized-tickets
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-17 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation. Opposite stance: ours sizes tickets by decision coherence and dependencies, not an assumed context-window size (.claude/skills/wayfinder/SKILL.md:26-27).

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/wayfinder#one-ticket-per-session
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-17 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation. Opposite stance: ours continues through further authorized ready tickets and sets no one-ticket-per-session limit (.claude/skills/wayfinder/SKILL.md:58-59).

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/wayfinder#research-subagent-branch
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-17 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation. Ours makes direct lookups fine and delegation optional; a mandatory subagent on a research branch conflicts with proportional delegation (U-07, C-14) (.claude/skills/wayfinder/SKILL.md:29-30).

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/wayfinder#research-branch-pr-policy
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-17 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation. Ours has no research branches (a research ticket calls the research skill), so a branch lifecycle rule has nothing to govern (.claude/skills/wayfinder/SKILL.md:29-30).

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/wayfinder#no-map-without-fog
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-17 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation. Ours routes a clear route back to mvp-mode for ordinary planning or execution instead of stopping to ask; U-02 reserves questions for materially different readings (.claude/skills/wayfinder/SKILL.md:11-12).

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/wayfinder#local-tracker-default
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-17 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation. Ours reports the blocker and refuses a competing Markdown tracker when Beads is unavailable (.claude/skills/wayfinder/SKILL.md:40-41).

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/wayfinder#grilling-default-type
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-17 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation. Ours runs a live interview only when one is requested; defaulting to grilling would ask the human for decisions research could settle (U-02) (.claude/skills/wayfinder/SKILL.md:32).

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/wayfinder#out-of-scope-final
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-17 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation. Ours closes an out-of-scope ticket with an explicit exclusion reason; a permanent ban on re-entry would block a legitimate re-scope inside the same map (S-08) (.claude/skills/wayfinder/SKILL.md:56).

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/wayfinder#map-initial-state
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-17 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation. The initial map follows from the five sections and the breadth-first charting rules; spelling out its first state is a recipe step (S-03) (.claude/skills/wayfinder/SKILL.md:17-18; .claude/skills/wayfinder/SKILL.md:45-48).

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/wayfinder#chart-only-session
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-17 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation. Ours continues into ready tickets while useful and authorized; forcing a stop after charting conflicts with carried authority (U-02) (.claude/skills/wayfinder/SKILL.md:58).

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/wayfinder#ticket-asset-pointers
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-17 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation. AGENTS.md already keeps large logs and histories behind references; a wayfinder-specific copy repeats it (S-05) (AGENTS.md:21).

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/research#claim-source-tracing
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-17 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation. Ours scales effort to what the caller must decide: it prefers current primary sources for changing facts and technical behaviour, asks high-stakes claims for primary sources or explicit uncertainty, and stops when remaining uncertainty no longer changes the answer; tracing every claim to the primary source that owns it over-spends on low-stakes ones (.claude/skills/research/SKILL.md:15; .claude/skills/research/SKILL.md:24-25; .claude/skills/research/references/source-selection.md:19).
